tools.name: intel_availability
tools.description: [v1.6.0] 先查：available_now、coverage、requires_trigger。建议再调 chain/signal/brief。Check coverage status first: available_now, coverage, requires_trigger. Then chain/signal/brief.

tools.name: intel_chain
tools.description: [v1.6.0] 全链：timeline、delta_days、vs_prior（≈get_chain）。需 Key。Full chain: timeline, delta_days, vs_prior. Requires key.

tools.name: intel_signal
tools.description: [v1.6.0] 规则缺口（≈list_signals）：落地、商业化、技术，另有链主倒逼无点名承接、海外有卖国内供给空。Rule gaps: landing, commercialization, tech, plus chain-master with no named receiver, and overseas sales with empty China supply.

tools.name: intel_heal
tools.description: [v1.6.0] 和本站上次快照比，缺口类型这次没了、还在、或新出现（healed / persistent / new）。会写下这次快照。Compare gap types with this site's last snapshot: gone, still here, or new. Writes this snapshot.

tools.name: intel_brief
tools.description: [v1.6.0] 规则模板拼的缺口组合：落地、商业化、技术，以及链主、跨境，哪几条在。不是大模型。Template of which gap combination is present. Not an LLM.

tools.name: intel_tech_daily
tools.description: [v1.6.0] 技术日报词矩阵，与 /tech-daily 同一批行。公开/免费只亮前 2 条，壁垒全表。Tech-word heat matrix. Public/free: top 2; pro: full.

tools.name: intel_tech_dir
tools.description: [v1.6.0] L-179 原子：一个技术方向。传 dir_id 或方向名。返回阶段、所属品类、线索。新闻线索 90 天，论文 24 个月。非壁垒最多 2 条且不给来源 URL；壁垒月卡给全量线索和 URL。只返回 JSON。Atomic tech direction by dir_id or name. News 90 days, papers 24 months. Non-pro: max 2 clues, no source URL. Pro: full clues with URLs. JSON only.

tools.name: intel_global_race
tools.description: [v1.6.0] L-179 原子：一个品类的全球竞争。必传品类 slug。返回国内 S 码、国外 S 码、差距、对位日期。日期以对位日为准，不是滚动 30 天。非壁垒不给来源 URL；壁垒月卡给来源。只返回 JSON。Atomic global race for one category slug. Domestic S, foreign S, gap, as-of. Not a rolling 30-day feed. Non-pro: no source URLs. Pro: sources. JSON only.

tools.name: intel_tech_launch
tools.description: [v1.6.0] L-179 原子：一个品类的技术启动。必传品类 slug。返回作价入股、出资、合资等转化动作，含日期。近窗 48 个月。非壁垒最多 2 条且不给来源 URL；壁垒月卡给该品类全量动作和来源。只返回 JSON。Atomic tech launch for one category slug. Window 48 months. Non-pro: max 2, no source URL. Pro: full actions with sources. JSON only.

tools.name: intel_demand
tools.description: [v1.6.0] 需求倒逼（品类匿名 signals/chains）。list=1 列实体；或传 entity/slug。公开前 3 条 signal、无 chains。Demand-pull. list=1 or entity. Public: 3 signals, no chains.

tools.name: intel_category
tools.description: [v1.6.0] 品类全包（肥）。优先用原子工具降 token：intel_category_opportunity / _supply / _demand_pull / _migration。Full category pack. Prefer atomic siblings to cut tokens.

tools.name: intel_category_opportunity
tools.description: [v1.6.0] L-153a 原子：只出品类机会面（海外/价差/切入点等），已按档裁剪。Atomic: opportunity slice only.

tools.name: intel_category_supply
tools.description: [v1.6.0] L-153a 原子：只出品类供给（整机/零部件示意），已按档裁剪。Atomic: supply slice only.

tools.name: intel_category_demand_pull
tools.description: [v1.6.0] L-153a 原子：只出需求倒逼段（signals/chains），公开无 chains。Atomic: demand_pull slice only.

tools.name: intel_category_migration
tools.description: [v1.6.0] L-153a 原子：技术迁移层。非壁垒仅标题示意/锁定；全量需壁垒。Atomic: tech_migration. Non-pro: teaser/locked only.

tools.name: intel_chain_master
tools.description: [v1.6.0] 已发布的链主倒逼。承接方不是定点供应商。公开/免费档不给来源 URL。Published chain-master push. Public/free tiers hide source URLs.
